mnemonic: Yishmael the priest helps the priests

R' Akiva: as the covering fat is spread loose, has a membrane and peels, so all [fat] spread loose with a membrane that peels
R' Yochanan: such is the layout of the teaching [the second baraita]; reverse the first
kosher fat seals [a perforation]
non-kosher fat does not seal

the ground of Rav's 'kosher fat seals' is that it is firmly attached

honey is not subject to [the prohibition of] exposure

and likewise R' Shimon ben Elazar would forbid [exposed] honey
Rav Nachman: fat shaped like a hat does not seal
some say: [it is] the grains [of fat] of the rectum

the bar chimtza seals
the chimtza does not seal
Rav Tavot: mnemonic -- the power of the son exceeds the power of the father
Rav Nachman: they [in Eretz Yisrael] eat it, and for us it would not even seal?! [it seals]
the fat on the bow [of the abomasum] is forbidden
the fat on the bow is permitted
the fat on the bowstring is forbidden
the fat on the bowstring is permitted
one takes off a handful [of the fat], and [the rest] is eaten

R' Chanina to his attendant: you are a Babylonian -- cut [it all] off and throw it away

there is no halakha following RSBG on the tereifa
there is no halakha following R' Shimon on mourning
Shmuel: in mourning, the halakha follows the words of the more lenient

Rav Mesharshiya: how many hands handled these [original perforations] before they came before the master
Rava: my son is as wise in tereifot as R' Yochanan
R' Yochanan and R' Elazar: one compares in the lung
Rava: we said it only within the same side [of the lung]

the halakha: even from side to side

the halakha: but not from large to small nor from small to large

the halakha: even from ring to ring

the halakha: but not from ring to sub-ring nor from sub-ring to ring

not at the place of attachment -- by any amount
